name: gsheets-mcp
description: Inspect, search and EDIT Google Sheets that were shared with you — in place, cell by cell, without pulling the file into the context. Every write is previewed and confirmed. Your credentials stay on your machine.

client_id.title: OAuth client ID
client_id.description: From the OAuth client you created in your own Google Cloud project. See the README. Leave all three fields empty to use a credentials file instead ($GSHEETS_MCP_CREDENTIALS, default ~/.config/pappcorn-gsheets-mcp/credentials.json).

client_secret.title: OAuth client secret
client_secret.description: From the same OAuth client. Stored in your OS keychain, never written to disk by this plugin.

refresh_token.title: Refresh token
refresh_token.description: Minted by the setup script after you log in as the account whose spreadsheets you want the assistant to work with. Grants access to that one account only — never to anyone else's Drive.
